scope: Seven finite/local groups. No measurable-cocycle, topological, geometric headline theorem or Lean proof certified.

stationary_graphs.controls: Equal exponents leave graph freedom; 2^(-n) on the infinite counting-measure shift contracts without vanishing.

tempered_green_series.zero_exponent_control: L=1, e=0 has all constant solutions.

schur_complements.control: Negative H prime reverses the sign of the square term.

graded_modules.scope: Nilpotent torsion and prescribed free degree shifts; no Gysin or localization computation.

bounded_death.control: A bar dying at 100 survives the tested short interval when the bounded-death hypothesis is omitted.

spherical_constraints.scope: Centroid and feasible cap formulas only; no constrained optimum or topological detection computation.
